# Kodarai

> Kodarai is a sales-to-website workflow for freelancers and agencies that sell websites to local businesses.

Kodarai helps users find local businesses without websites, generate a professional business website from verified lead information, preview and edit that website, and publish a live URL to share with the business owner.

## Core workflow

1. Find a lead in Lead Finder.
2. Select **Build Website** for a business without a website.
3. Generate controlled, responsive website files in Kodarai Builder.
4. Preview the real files at desktop, tablet, and mobile sizes.
5. Edit with AI or Monaco, save changes, then publish through Kodarai's managed Vercel deployment.

## Product areas

- [Homepage](https://kodarai.xyz/): Product overview and plans.
- [Sales Academy](https://kodarai.xyz/learn): Free lessons on cold calling and selling web design services.
- [Contact](https://kodarai.xyz/contact): Contact the Kodarai team.

## Audience

Freelance web designers, agencies, and local-business service providers who want a focused workflow for finding prospects and selling websites. Kodarai is not a general-purpose AI coding platform.
